1. Cast Doomed Dissenter for {1}{B}. 
2. Activate Defiant Salvager's ability by sacrificing Doomed Dissenter. 
   - Wayward Disciple triggers, draining the opponent for 1 (Opponent's life: 9).
   - Doomed Dissenter triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
   - Defiant Salvager gets a +1/+1 counter (now 3/3).
3. Activate Liliana, Death's Majesty's -3 loyalty ability, targeting Doomed Dissenter in your graveyard. It returns to the battlefield as a Zombie.
4. Activate Defiant Salvager's ability again, sacrificing the returned Doomed Dissenter.
   - Wayward Disciple triggers, draining the opponent for 1 (Opponent's life: 8).
   - Doomed Dissenter triggers, creating a second 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
   - Defiant Salvager gets another +1/+1 counter (now 4/4).
5. Cast Trial of Solidarity for {2}{W}. All creatures you control get +2/+1 and vigilance. 
   - Bontu the Glorified becomes a 6/7.
   - Defiant Salvager becomes a 6/5.
   - Wayward Disciple becomes a 4/5.
   - The two Zombie tokens become 4/3s (but have summoning sickness so they cannot attack).
6. Move to combat and declare Bontu the Glorified, Defiant Salvager, and Wayward Disciple as attackers. (Bontu can attack because creatures have died under your control this turn).
   - Bontu has Menace and requires two blockers. The opponent has Aven Mindcensor (2/1) and Faithbearer Paladin (3/4 lifelink).
   - To survive, the opponent must block Defiant Salvager with Faithbearer Paladin and Wayward Disciple with Aven Mindcensor.
   - Bontu the Glorified goes unblocked, dealing 6 damage to the opponent. 
   - Faithbearer Paladin deals 3 damage to Defiant Salvager, gaining the opponent 3 life (Opponent's life: 8 - 6 + 3 = 5). Both Defiant Salvager and Wayward Disciple survive their combat damage while killing the opponent's blockers.
7. Move to your post-combat main phase. You still have your free sacrifice outlet (Defiant Salvager) and Wayward Disciple on the battlefield to orchestrate a chain of drains.
   - Sacrifice your first Zombie token to Defiant Salvager. Wayward Disciple drains for 1 (Opponent's life: 4).
   - Sacrifice your second Zombie token to Defiant Salvager. Wayward Disciple drains for 1 (Opponent's life: 3).
   - Sacrifice Bontu the Glorified to Defiant Salvager. Wayward Disciple drains for 1 (Opponent's life: 2).
   - Sacrifice Wayward Disciple to Defiant Salvager. Wayward Disciple sees itself die and triggers one final time, draining the opponent for 1 (Opponent's life: 1).
   - Note: If the opponent blocks differently (for example, double-blocking Bontu), they take lethal combat damage from your unblocked creatures instantly or fall to 0 through the resulting post-combat drain triggers.

comp_rules.txt

Puzzle conventions:
Winning
Unless otherwise stated, you must win the puzzle by inflicting lethal damage to your opponent before the turn ends. This can be as late as during the cleanup step if necessary. Your solution must work for all possible outcomes, such as your opponent’s actions and blocking decisions (see below.)
Phase
Unless otherwise stated, you begin each puzzle at the beginning of your first main phase. You have already drawn a card and gone past upkeep triggers. You have not yet played a land, cast any spells, activated any abilities of permanents on the battlefield, or attacked.
Your Opponent’s Resources / Actions
Unless otherwise stated, your opponent has no cards in hand and no other permanents in play (including no lands – despite the lack of realism there.) This means the only actions you need to consider are activated abilities with no mana cost. Most puzzles with opponent actions will offer more information on this.
Blocking
You cannot assume that your opponent will block a certain way, unless they are somehow forced to. Your solution must satisfy all possible blocking scenarios, even ones that would seem strange in a regular game, and always deal lethal in order to be correct.
Dice
Sometimes you will see six-sided dice placed on cards. These are meant to indicate counters, of whatever type is most reasonable to be there. On most creatures they will be +1/+1 counters, on most artifacts and lands they will be charge counters, and on most Planeswalkers they will be loyalty counters.
If the card specifies a type of counter itself, however (like Icatian Javelineers or Raging Ravine), that will dictate which type it is. 
For -1/-1 counters, we will use a separate graphic to avoid confusion.
Zones
Unless otherwise stated, all zones not displayed are empty. Neither you nor your opponent have cards in graveyards or in exile.
Cards Drawn from Libraries
In any puzzle in which either player might draw cards or otherwise access their library, the puzzle will stipulate some known or assumed information about the library.
Most commonly, this will be a statement that you should assume that the cards remaining in libraries are to be assumed to be irrelevant to the puzzle.
Your Life
Occasionally, your own life total might appear to matter – for cards like Anguished Unmaking, for example. If we require you to consider your own life total in a puzzle, it will be displayed.
If your life total is not shown, you may assume it is irrelevant and effectively infinite.

When you are ready to answer, put your final winning line inside <solution> tags:

<solution>
1. First step...
2. Second step...
</solution>

Your line must be legal under the rules and must win against all possible opponent responses and blocking decisions.

To win this turn, you need to maximize the number of creatures dying under your control to trigger Wayward Disciple's life drain, while also pushing through as much combat damage as possible with Trial of Solidarity.

<solution>
1. Cast Doomed Dissenter for {1}{B}. 
2. Activate Defiant Salvager's ability by sacrificing Doomed Dissenter. 
   - Wayward Disciple triggers, draining the opponent for 1 (Opponent's life: 9).
   - Doomed Dissenter triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
   - Defiant Salvager gets a +1/+1 counter (now 3/3).
3. Activate Liliana, Death's Majesty's -3 loyalty ability, targeting Doomed Dissenter in your graveyard. It returns to the battlefield as a Zombie.
4. Activate Defiant Salvager's ability again, sacrificing the returned Doomed Dissenter.
   - Wayward Disciple triggers, draining the opponent for 1 (Opponent's life: 8).
   - Doomed Dissenter triggers, creating a second 2/2 black Zombie creature token.
   - Defiant Salvager gets another +1/+1 counter (now 4/4).
5. Cast Trial of Solidarity for {2}{W}. All creatures you control get +2/+1 and vigilance. 
   - Bontu the Glorified becomes a 6/7.
   - Defiant Salvager becomes a 6/5.
   - Wayward Disciple becomes a 4/5.
   - The two Zombie tokens become 4/3s (but have summoning sickness so they cannot attack).
6. Move to combat and declare Bontu the Glorified, Defiant Salvager, and Wayward Disciple as attackers. (Bontu can attack because creatures have died under your control this turn).
   - Bontu has Menace and requires two blockers. The opponent has Aven Mindcensor (2/1) and Faithbearer Paladin (3/4 lifelink).
   - To survive, the opponent must block Defiant Salvager with Faithbearer Paladin and Wayward Disciple with Aven Mindcensor.
   - Bontu the Glorified goes unblocked, dealing 6 damage to the opponent.
